notes:
- Miss a call on your iPhone from a number that isn't in your contacts, and your agent sends you
  a card with a text back, ready to go through Messages on your Mac. Nothing sends until you press
  Send. Turn it on in Text Replies, under Missed calls, or say yes when your agent offers it.
- On your own AI account, Email Manager moves mail that pretends to be a company out of your
  inbox: an unpaid toll, a package held for a fee or a locked account, sent from an address or
  link that isn't that company's. It goes into a Likely scams folder, your agent tells you in your
  chat, and Put back brings it back. Text Replies warns you about a text like it. The switch is
  under Also watch for.
- Send a waiting reply from its notification, with Archie Mobile 1.9. When a reply waiting on
  Send fits in the notification, the notification has Send, Edit and Not now. Pressing Send in two
  places at once still sends one reply.
- When a website signs your agent out and the browser your agent uses has the password saved,
  it presses Sign in itself, once per site. When a site asks for a code, reply with it and Archie
  types it in without the AI seeing it. Turn on Find sign-in codes in texts and email (Connections
  tab, under Computer control) and Archie looks for the code itself.
- From your next update on, you can go back to the version you had before, for two weeks, in
  Settings under Updates or from Archie Mobile. Archie saves a copy of every agent just before an
  update installs, and tells you what goes back and what stays before you press anything.
- A change a routine wants to make waits on a card under its report instead of being refused.
  Nothing changes until you press Confirm, any time in the next 14 days.
- Yes, and stop asking now covers two more things: changes you ask for in the files you gave
  your agent, and new pages in Notion or new rows in Airtable. Each one has an Undo.
- Ask your agent to take something off a list and it does it right away, with Undo. What it
  took off is kept for 30 days so Undo can put it back.
- A to-do your agent adds in Todoist or Google Tasks has an Undo that takes it back off the list.
- Tell us it went wrong: open a job on the Jobs tab and press it. Archie shows you the job's
  record, then opens it in your own email app, addressed to us. Nothing is sent until you press Send
  there.
- On a Mac, you can see where your agent works in an app you let it use. The Archie mark moves
  to each button it presses and each box it types in, when that app's window is the one in front.
- When an email settles a new time for a meeting, your agent offers the card that moves it, as
  it already did for texts.
- "Can you add Dana?" now adds her, the same as "Add Dana", with Undo.
- A scanned PDF you hand your agent is read without turning a switch on first. The switch is
  still there for scans that come in by email.
- A text with a sign-in code or a PIN stays away from the AI whenever Archie looks back through
  that conversation, not only when it arrives.
- A new agent started from one you already have gets its store skills as store installs, so
  their updates reach it too.
- On Archie for Teams, a teammate who joins on Archie Mobile is told the owner can read what they
  write, before the agent first answers them.
- Fixed: pressing the card that moves a meeting to a time someone agreed on did not move it.
- Fixed: a meeting canceled in Outlook or iCloud could still show on the Calendar tab or come up as
  your next one.
- Turning on Zoom recordings downloads the speech tools Archie needs to read them, if this
  computer doesn't have them yet.
- Fixed: quitting Archie left your agents' browsers open.
